summary: INVO Fertility, Inc. through its wholly owned subsidiary INVO Centers, LLC acquired 100% of the membership interests of HRCFG, LLC (operator of a fertility clinic joint venture in Birmingham, Alabama) per a Membership Interest Transfer Agreement dated June 23, 2026. Total consideration was $175,001: $1 cash at close, $48,000 payable in equal monthly installments over nine months starting October 2026, and $127,000 from HRCFG's free cash flow. Sellers Karen Hammond, Lisa Ray, and Nicholas Cataldo will provide transition services for four months and support for twelve months post-transition. The acquired clinic will be consolidated prospectively. Watch for integration and cash flow generation to fund deferred payments.
